Method of Attack: unauthenticated access token manipulation allowing attackers to access and manipulate token configurations; broken access control due to lack of permission and nonce validation in the init function
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using All-in-One WP Migration plugin and its premium extensions (Box, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of broken access control vulnerability (CVE-2023-40004) in premium extensions allowing unauthenticated users to manipulate token configurations
